native_operation: GTOS_SYS_WRITE /0x4701,EBX readable user buffer,ECX0..256bytes,EAX written bytes or negative error
kernel_contract: Validates and copies whole buffer before visible output. Native diagnostic sink; no POSIX descriptor. Does not touch C errno or use compiler TLS.
reference: Existing qualified V8 WriteError chunks at GTOS_NATIVE_WRITE_LIMIT and rejects zero or unsigned result greater than requested bytes.
edge_review: Chunk caps every request at256; a valid short positive result advances only that prefix.
Zero, negative-as-unsigned or oversized results stop without a retry loop or fake successful byte count.
Pointer and remaining-length arithmetic advances only after a result in1..chunk.
Raw diagnostic output must not take a heap lock, initialize TLS or format through stdio. Existing log severity/fatal handling remains unchanged.
